title: On a Board View card, a focused avatar shows the technician's name
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are active at {Location-A}, and "Line technicians" is on in Board View's "Fields to display".
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682438 Ana and ZZAUTOTEST C682438 Ben.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an Approved work order {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A}, with {Technician-B} on one of its lines.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682438 Avatar Keys.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", nothing focused yet.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click once in the "Search" box.
  2. Press Tab until a card shows the focus ring.
  3. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for {Work-order-1}.
  4. Press Tab until one of the card's avatars has the focus.
  5. Press Tab again to move to the next avatar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the cursor is in "Search".
  • Step 2: a card shows the focus ring.
  • Step 3: the card for {Work-order-1} shows the focus ring.
  • Step 4: the focused avatar shows its technician's name, the same as on hover.
  • Step 5: the next avatar has the focus and shows its technician's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus), story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); ticket SV-11409

  • S11-R2: “Every control a mouse can use in Tech View and Board View is reachable with Tab and works with Enter or Space, as the design system’s menus and dialogs do: the more-actions button (which appears on keyboard focus, S3-R13), the Columns options, the x on a filter chip, and the display switcher. Technician names behind avatars show on keyboard focus, the same as on hover.”

Not yet checked against a build.
